Hollywood celebrities treat themselves to dinner at a nightclub.

Tom steals a witch's broomstick in order to scare Jerry with it.

Tom frames the bulldog, Spike, for stealing chicken from the fridge, but Jerry uses photography to prove Spike's innocence.

A lost puppy follows Jerry home.
Tom and Jerry are in Kenya on a hunting safari and don't get along as usual.
Tom believes at first that he is going on a cruise, but the captain of the Kumquat soon puts him to work scrubbing the deck.
A mad scientist's experiments have Tom in a tizzy.
Jerry brews a mysterious drink that triggers a change in him after he drinks it, making him fast enough to eat the food out of Tom's paw without the cat realizing what is happening to him.
The gang's boat collides with a freighter manned by Redbeard the pirate and a ghost crew.
A millionaire promises his fortune to anyone who will spend the night in his haunted castle.
The kids stumble upon an abominable snow creature while on vacation.
Numbuh One is wrongly accused of being 13 years old and ambushed by a decommissioning squad led by Numbuh 86; with no access to his team or his Treehouse, he must rely on his skills and help.
Count Spankulot tries to join the Kids; Numbuh One uses a date as a reconnaissance mission.

Chowder must make a complicated dish; Panini decides that Chowder is her boyfriend.
Clarence creates his own form of currency, turning the school upside down.
Clarence tries to become a perfect gentleman before a date.
Jeff and Clarence clash over keeping a toy in its box.
When Clarence attends a stuffy dinner party with his mother, he tries to find fun wherever he can.
A disembodied spirit terrorizes baseball games.
When Shaggy wins a trip to the Scooby Snack Factory, the gang prepare for a well deserved holiday. Unfortunately, the ghost of a former employee is lurking in the shadows!
